title: Repair target ambiguity in target-blind twist progression bases
status_note: New proposed diagnostic, not implemented/run/funded. The prior rank check certifies ambiguity for only one base. Generalized complete collection, matched controls, input/spec pins and sizing are required before readiness.
blocked_on: note:Implement independent native/CAS instruments, freeze protocol/source/input and measure bounded sizing before execution.
question: Which fixed target-blind progression bases remove the observed target-nullspace direction, with matched ordinary bases and every failed fill retained?
decision_value: Every planned configuration independently replayed in native Rust/GP, with exact witness sets, deduplicated coefficient rows, ranks, target-nullspace projections and public-point recovery checks. Different bases produce different tasks; report exact configurations rather than a generic speedup. No cost advantage without a separately frozen complete cold panel.

resources.notes: Use only public p827 and the certified source/maps. Fix B8/12/16, shifts1/3, first/maximal twist seeds, arity2/3 and offsets0–15 before data. Include ordinary ascending/curve-orbit controls with the same B. Preserve underfills, all signed multiplicities and every zero case. Compare target identifiability via full nullspace, not row counts or full-system rank alone. No original E28 labels32–63, new secret targets or outcome-dependent refill. Charge discovery and collection before any cost claim. Prospective300s/4GiB envelope is unmeasured and grants no funded allocation.
